summary.intent: Decide whether Phase 72 needed discussion or could go straight to planning, reconcile drift between pending todos and Phases 70/70.1/71/72/73, then plan/execute Phase 72 — which was interrupted by discovering and fixing three CI regressions (web-e2e, desktop-e2e, sdk-e2e) traced to Phases 70.1/71 before Phase 72 planning could resume.
summary.outcome: Confirmed Phase 72 was debt-cleanup (no discussion needed), retired 8 stale Phase 71 todos to completed/, folded zeroize and 68.2-coderabbit-hardening todos into 72/73 source lists, and diagnosed/fixed three CI regressions across PR #600 (web-e2e floor helper + CodeRabbit nit + sdk-e2e Test 21 idempotency fix) and PR #601 (FUSE seq-equivocation fix + stale .mts DTO field rename + Greptile-suggested perf optimization to avoid double-resolve). Phase 72 planning remains paused/stashed pending both PRs merging.

repo: This repo retires todos by deleting the file from pending/ (moving to completed/), not by editing in place — an empty resolved/ or todos still in pending/ after a phase ships signals drift
Phase 71 (#599) shipped without retiring its 8 source todos from pending/, unlike Phase 70/70.1 which correctly moved theirs to completed/

ci-e2e.yml (bundles Web E2E + Desktop E2E mount tests) only triggers on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on PRs — so e2e regressions aren't caught pre-merge; separate desktop-e2e.yml/web-e2e.yml support workflow_dispatch with a ref input for pre-merge validation
workflow_dispatch requires `--ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=...`) on this repo's older workflow definition to run from and check out a branch's head

Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water, seq-high-water) into one rotation-floor store (DB v2, keyed by nodeId) — old store names are gone, so any helper still probing them silently returns undefined

Phase 71 renamed share DTO fields (readDescriptorRef→encryptedReadKey, rootIpnsName→shareRootIpnsName) but didn't update tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/shared-scope-exit-rotation.mts, causing stale field 400s

FUSE first-publish path in crates/fuse/src/content_ops.rs hardcoded seq=1 gated only on 'inode cid empty', so a dropped/stale UploadComplete re-triggering first-publish with a new CID collided with Phase 71's same-seq/different-CID anti-equivocation gate
publish_with_cas_retry (crates/fuse/src/metadata.rs) is the shared CAS helper for both folder and file publish paths; only two real callers (content_ops.rs file-publish, metadata.rs bin-publish)
web-e2e suite has a persistent flake rate (~4/6 recent runs) with different specs failing each run (Web3Auth login, locator timeouts) — needs re-run confirmation before trusting green/red
sdk-e2e Test 21 (D-06 concurrent first-publish) asserted exactly one 409, but Phase 71's same-CID idempotency allows two legitimate 200s, making the original assertion flaky by design

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on first-publish branch; fixed to resolve IPNS name first and only take the seq=1 path if genuinely absent, else fall through to publish_with_cas_retry (matching replay.rs's resolve-first idiom) — later extended to pass a pre-resolved seq into the CAS call to avoid a redundant resolve round-trip (Greptile P2 nit)
readDurableFloors helper referenced pre-Phase-70.1 IndexedDB store names; fixed to read from the collapsed rotation-floor store

POST /shares body and received-share reads used stale pre-Phase-71 DTO field names (readDescriptorRef, rootIpnsName), causing forbidNonWhitelisted 400s; renamed to encryptedReadKey/shareRootIpnsName (leaving unrelated same-named vault-response local vars alone)
Test 21 rewritten to accept both insert-race (200+409) and idempotent (two 200s) outcomes for concurrent same-CID first-publish, while still rejecting 5xx or missing winners

workflow: When a task-notification arrives for a background agent while another is still pending, keep working/summarizing what's in hand rather than polling — wait for the natural notification
Before merging a fix whose validating e2e suite only runs on main-push, use workflow_dispatch with --ref against the fix branch to get pre-merge runtime proof instead of merging blind
When stashing in-progress uncommitted work to switch context for urgent fixes, explicitly track the stash ref (stash@{0}) and communicate its safety to the user throughout

Verify subagent-proposed patches against real source (grep for symbol existence, read actual function signatures) before applying, especially for compiled languages like Rust where a plausible-sounding patch may not compile
Root-cause diagnosis for CI failures benefits from parallel agents split by CI leg (web-e2e vs desktop-e2e) to avoid one large log dump consuming context

When a re-run surfaces a new failure after a fix, distinguish 'fix worked but exposed a downstream issue' (progress) from 'fix didn't work' by checking whether the original error signature is actually gone from logs, not just whether the job is still red

friction: The `phase uat-passed` CLI gap noted in memory wasn't hit here, but GSD planning was interrupted mid-flow by CI discovery, requiring careful branch/stash hygiene to avoid losing uncommitted Phase 72 bookkeeping
workflow_dispatch with `-f ref=` was rejected due to an outdated workflow input definition on main; had to discover the working `--ref` flag form by trial and error
Desktop-e2e and web-e2e don't run on PR CI at all (only ci-e2e.yml which is main-push/dispatch-only), so both fixes needed manual dispatch for real pre-merge validation — an extra unplanned step
sdk-e2e failed on PR #600 despite the PR only touching an unrelated web-e2e spec, requiring a separate diagnosis to confirm it was a pre-existing Phase 71 flake and not caused by the PR

Phase 71 (#599) shipped with three separate pieces of undetected test/fixture drift (stale .mts DTO fields, flaky Test 21 assertion, and the real FUSE seq-1 bug) — none caught before merge because e2e doesn't gate PRs
